turns.q: Is there a warranty or guarantee if something goes wrong?
turns.replyTail: there is a 30-day return and exchange period from delivery for eligible items. Items must be unwashed, show no signs of wear, have original tags attached, and not be marked FINAL SALE. If an item arrives damaged or develops a defect, you can submit a request through the return portal and select Item was damaged, including clear images. Submissions are reviewed within 2–3 business days. Even final-sale or otherwise non-returnable items may be reviewed if they arrive wrong, damaged, or defective.
